consumer: mission::is_complete for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM, which asks 'does the player possess the required count of the part within crafting reach so the fetch mission can be turned in?'
scope: items reachable nearby (the player's crafting_inventory: carried items plus adjacent/reachable resources), not only the character's own carried items
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — computes a bool by testing u.crafting_inventory().has_amount(item_id,count), falling back to has_amount(item_id,1)&&has_charges(item_id,count); the engine evaluates this yes/no to gate mission completion
divergence: the required part sits in adjacent vehicle cargo or on the ground within crafting reach but not in the character's worn/wielded/inv; true is_complete returns true via crafting_inventory, while an on-person possession check (Excerpt 2/Excerpt 1 traversal) returns false — wrong answer exposed
